subject: Kickoff: Tiered milestone sequencing & point-people
messages:
From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@lumenhealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: impl-team@lumenhealth.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Tiered milestone sequencing & point-people

Hi Sofia / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to lock in a mutual action plan (MAP) and assign owners so we can make our September pilot target. High level asks from Lumen:
- Short ramp (6 weeks) for core NLU + knowledge connector
- One integration sprint with our infra team (on-prem connector)
- Compliance checklist (data flows, RBAC, retention) to satisfy InfoSec

Can you propose a tiered milestone sequence (critical path vs. nice-to-have) and who from Redwood will own each line? Also list any procurement prerequisites that block the first sprint.

Thanks — Jenna
Jenna Ortiz
Head of Clinical Operations
Lumen Health

[Attachment: Lumen_kickoff_request.pdf]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Tiered milestone sequencing & point-people

Hi Jenna —

Appreciate the clear asks. I attached a first-draft MAP (Lumen_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks milestones into three tiers:

Tier 1 (Critical path, must before pilot)
- Prod-ready model selection & pin (owner: Sofia) — target: 2026-07-02
- On-prem connector validation (owner: Karthik) — target: 2026-07-09
- Compliance evidence bundle & retention policy sign-off (owner: Marissa) — target: 2026-07-12

Tier 2 (Pilot features)
- Knowledge connector expansions (owner: Lumen infra + Karthik) — target: 2026-07-30
- Prompt/eval baseline & success metrics (owner: Sofia + Lumen Ops) — target: 2026-08-06

Tier 3 (Nice-to-have, post-pilot)
- Reranking & throughput optimization (owner: Redwood infra) — target: 2026-09-01
- Cost/perf knobs and autoscale policy (owner: Ben) — target: 2026-09-10

Procurement blockers we see today: enterprise contract signature (SOW + MSA), customer KMS key exchange, and IP addendum for on-prem logging. Ben — can you confirm the expected lead time for DocuSign on the SOW?

I included short contingency items in the spreadsheet (fallback model variants, temporary cloud staging) — we should agree on them now so they’re executable if the on-prem connector slips.

Proposed next steps:
1) Review MAP_v1 and comment in the Drive (link in last message).
2) Ben to push SOW to DocuSign and confirm procurement ETA.
3) Karthik to schedule a 60-min validation call with Lumen infra for 2026-06-24.

If that looks good I’ll lock the Tier 1 dates and create a shared calendar with milestone owners.

Cheers,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Lumen_MAP_v1.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Tiered milestone sequencing & point-people

All — quick update from procurement side. I’ve uploaded a stub SOW (Redwood_SOW_stub.pdf) and initiated a DocuSign envelope: https://docuSign.com/embedded?envelopeId=ABC12345. Our legal has flagged two items that typically add time: KMS key handoff and the on-prem logging clause. If Lumen can accept our standard KMS process (HSM handshake + short audit log retention) we can keep signature to a 7–10 day window.

Action for Lumen: can you share the procurement contact and preferred signatory (name + email)? I’ll CC them into the DocuSign envelope and expedite.

Also, small ask on timing: if we can shift the model pin from 07/02 to 07/05 it gives infra a little breathing room without affecting the critical path (still keeps pilot window intact). Jenna — is that acceptable?

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Tiered milestone sequencing & point-people

Thanks everyone — quick consolidation and risk/fallbacks: 

Finalized Tier 1 (locked pending SOW sign):
- Model pin (owner: Sofia) — 2026-07-05 (agreed with Ben)
- On-prem connector validation (owner: Karthik) — 2026-07-11 (validation call booked 06/24)
- Compliance evidence & retention sign-off (owner: Marissa) — 2026-07-13

Risks & fallbacks (agree now):
- If on-prem connector > 2 weeks late: run pilot in Redwood-managed staging for 4 weeks (temporary cloud staging) — Decision owner: Jenna
- If SOW signature delays > 10 days: we’ll scope a narrow tech pilot (no PHI) to validate integration while contract completes — Decision owner: Ben
- If KMS exchange extends: use customer-supplied ephemeral keys + audit window until HSM setup completes — Decision owner: Marissa

Next immediate steps (this week):
- Jenna: please provide procurement contact for DocuSign (reply with name + email).
- Ben: please confirm DocuSign envelope progress and expected signature ETA.
- Karthik: share proposed calendar for the 06/24 infra validation (60-min) and list preflight artifacts (API spec, access hostnames).

I’ve pushed an editable MAP to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-Lumen-MAP — please comment directly in the spreadsheet (Lumen_MAP_v1.xlsx). I’ll update the shared milestone calendar once we have procurement ETA.

If no objections I’ll set the Tier 1 locks by EOD Wednesday 2026-06-23.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
